property_summary: For any user, after addToBalance (deposit) and a following withdrawBalance, the contract's total ETH balance must equal the sum of all user balances recorded in the mapping; the mutant fails because withdrawBalance deducts the full userBalance but sends only 1 wei, leaving excess ETH in the contract.
change_summary: Replace the external call value with a hardcoded 1 wei instead of userBalance[msg.sender].
